COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPSS/1730/2025
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. N.K. Papnoi, learned Standing
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Pankaj Miglani, learned counsel
for the respondent no. 3 - Commission.
4. Petitioner's name was not included
in the select list due to the fact that he
could not appear for document
verification before the Selecting Body in
time. The Selecting Body has
recommended names of selected
candidates to the Appointing Authority.
5. In this writ petition, petitioner
contends that since no recommendation
was made in respect of three vacancies
reserved for Scheduled Caste category;
petitioner belongs to that category and
his score of marks is more than the
marks scored by last candidate in that
category, therefore, he has a right to be
considered for appointment against one
of the three unfilled vacancies.
6. Since Selecting Body has become
functus officio after recommendation,
therefore, no purpose would be served
by referring the matter to Selecting
Body.
7. Learned State Counsel is right in
submitting that petitioner himself is to be
blamed for not appearing before

2025:UHC:9517
Selecting Body for document verification
on the given date & time and also not
approaching this Court, while the process
of document verification was on.
8. Be that as it may, since petitioner
has allegedly scored 128 marks in the
selection process, and according to him,
Scheduled Caste category candidate with
106 marks was recommended for
appointment, therefore, the writ petition
is disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
approach the Appointing Authority by
making representation. If petitioner
makes representation within one week
from today, Competent Authority shall
take decision thereupon, within four
weeks thereafter.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 29.10.2025
Aswal
